<Activity x:Class="ProcessStartTrigger" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities" xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <ui:ProcessStartTrigger ContinueMonitoring="{x:Null}" ContinueOnError="{x:Null}" ProcessName="{x:Null}">
    <ui:ProcessStartTrigger.Body>
      <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="ui:ProcessInfo">
        <ActivityAction.Argument>
          <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="ui:ProcessInfo" Name="ProcessInfo" />
        </ActivityAction.Argument>
        <Sequence DisplayName="実行" />
      </ActivityAction>
    </ui:ProcessStartTrigger.Body>
  </ui:ProcessStartTrigger>
</Activity>
